items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Man, Celestine was playing up on the bandstand with us at the temple, I swear to God.

ctx.x: Well, say you had at that early period, before California, say you finished that three choruses ensemble, who would take down?

Who would take down? Yeah. Well, if the trumpet player might want to take a solo. Oh, after three ensembles he'd still be strong enough? Man, Celestine looked like he played for hours. Man, Celestine was playing up on the bandstand with us at the temple, I swear to God. He played a tune so long it was pitiful. I'm telling you, it was not nastush, you know. Ain't nothing but chorus. It's the same thing, you know. Man, that man would play chorus, man, after chorus, chorus after chorus. Wouldn't allow us to play…
Then they'd pick up a, oh, man, I swear to God, that people played so long, man. Oh, man.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And the first bands I heard was the old Onward Band, the Excelsior Band, and Papa Celestan's Tuxedo Band

ctx.x: That's right. They had one here.

That's right. Oh, they had more then. Yeah, it was on a Monday. See, the parade was on a Monday and the picnic was that night at the fairgrounds. And the first bands I heard was the old Onward Band, the Excelsior Band, and Papa Celestan's Tuxedo Band, which at that time it was Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. Oh, yeah. Bebe Ridgely's Tuxedo Band.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know.

ctx.x: Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.

See, I never heard their band. They'd tell me they had fine bands, you know. I know most of the musical bands, you know. See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know, Piku, Teal, you know. Always had good musicians they did, you know. See, good reading musicians, you know. You get it? But all the band like Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan, they were a little tongue band. Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know. They had a nice musical band. Nice rhythm section, a little Chani on…
So those were some of the outstanding men on the instruments. Those were some of the outstanding men on the guitar players, banjo players, bass, drums.
